name: FuzzyOasisParty
description: FuzzyOasisParty (绿洲派对, FOP) was a furry convention in Shenzhen, in southern China. Its project team began fundraising in January 2020 for a first convention planned for July 2020 at the Crowne Plaza Holiday Hotel in Longgang District, which was postponed because of the pandemic, and the first convention was held August 7 to 8, 2021, at the Yating Haiwan International Hotel, a seaside hotel in Yantian District. A "FuzzyOasisParty Lite" event followed in July 2023, and the project's final event was held in October 2023.
